proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING TO LOWER STOCK OWNERSHIP THRESHOLD TO CALL SPECIAL STOCKHOLDER MEETINGS
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend bylaws so holders of 15% of outstanding common stock may call a special shareowner meeting, lowering the current 25% threshold.
proposals.evidence: The Board unanimously recommends that you vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal for the reasons stated on page 57.
